parameters.name: crop_types
parameters.description: Set of crop types indexed by crop identifier p

parameters.name: livestock_types
parameters.description: Set of livestock types indexed by livestock identifier g

parameters.name: seasonal_labor_periods
parameters.description: Set of seasonal labor periods indexed by season identifier s

parameters.name: seasonal_labor_availability
parameters.description: Available farm labor days in each season s

parameters.name: external_work_wage
parameters.description: External-work earning rate in each season s

parameters.name: crop_labor_requirement
parameters.description: Labor days required per land unit for each crop p in each season s

parameters.name: crop_net_income
parameters.description: Annual net income per land unit for each crop p

parameters.name: livestock_capital_requirement
parameters.description: Capital required per head of each livestock type g

parameters.name: livestock_land_requirement
parameters.description: Land required per head of each livestock type g

parameters.name: livestock_labor_requirement
parameters.description: Labor days required per head of each livestock type g in each season s

parameters.name: livestock_net_income
parameters.description: Annual net income per head of each livestock type g

parameters.name: livestock_housing_capacity
parameters.description: Housing capacity for each livestock type g

variables.name: crop_area
variables.description: Land area assigned to each crop p

variables.name: livestock_count
variables.description: Number of animals raised of each livestock type g

variables.name: external_labor_days
variables.description: Number of farm labor days in each season s assigned to outside work

variables.name: total_annual_net_income
variables.description: Total annual net income of the operating plan

constraints.name: land_availability
constraints.description: Total land used for crops and livestock must not exceed available land

constraints.name: capital_availability
constraints.description: Total development capital used for livestock must not exceed available capital

constraints.name: seasonal_labor_balance
constraints.description: In each season, labor demand from crops and livestock must be covered by available farm labor, with any unused labor assigned to outside work
constraints.formula: \sum_{p\in\mathcal{P}} \ell_{p,s} x_p + \sum_{g\in\mathcal{G}} m_{g,s} y_g + o_s = H_s \quad \forall s\in\mathcal{S}

constraints.name: housing_capacity
constraints.description: Livestock head count for each type must not exceed its housing capacity

constraints.name: crop_area_nonnegative
constraints.description: Crop land allocations must be nonnegative

constraints.name: livestock_count_integrality
constraints.description: Livestock counts must be nonnegative integers

constraints.name: external_labor_days_integrality
constraints.description: External-work labor day assignments must be nonnegative integers

constraints.name: objective_variable_definition
constraints.description: Total annual net income equals the sum of crop income, livestock income, and outside-work income
constraints.formula: Z = \sum_{p\in\mathcal{P}} \pi_p x_p + \sum_{g\in\mathcal{G}} r_g y_g + \sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}} w_s o_s

objectives.name: total_annual_net_income_maximization
objectives.description: Maximize total annual net income from crop production, livestock production, and outside work using unused seasonal labor

final_objective.description: Maximize total annual net income from crop production, livestock production, and outside work. This is a single-objective MILP with a linear revenue expression.
final_objective.formula: \max Z = \sum_{p\in\mathcal{P}} \pi_p x_p + \sum_{g\in\mathcal{G}} r_g y_g + \sum_{s\in\mathcal{S}} w_s o_s
